content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional payment platforms like Stripe are severely restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in setting up online stores that can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-infrastructure-reality-check-2|Crypto Payments]] payments. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, offering a solution that empowers creators to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-until-you|COREMERCH guide to build]] and deploy their own digital stores on platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-9|cloudflare]] Pages, free from the constraints of traditional payment gateways.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be platform-agnostic, allowing creators to host their digital stores on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and process payments using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This approach ensures that creators have full ownership and control over their stores, without relying on third-party platforms that may be subject to restrictions or downtime. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can ensure that their stores remain operational, even in the face of platform outages or restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to have a few key components in place. First, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Pages account and configure your domain settings. Next, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and obtain an API key, which will be used to integrate crypto payments into your store. Finally, you'll need to prepare your digital products and configure your store's settings, including pricing, product descriptions, and delivery options.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages store. This involves configuring the NOWPayments API and setting up a payment gateway that can process crypto transactions. You'll also need to configure your delivery pipeline, which can be done using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation. By using a combination of these tools, you can create a seamless and automated payment and delivery process that requires minimal manual intervention.
Build a sovereign digital commerce stack that accepts payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've configured your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you'll need to test your store's functionality, including payment processing and product delivery, to ensure that everything is working as expected. You can do this by placing a test order and verifying that the payment is processed correctly and the product is delivered instantly. Once you've confirmed that your store is working correctly, you can start promoting it to customers and processing real transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start processing more transactions, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and demand. To do this, you can use Cloudflare Workers to optimize your store's performance and reduce latency, and Supabase to scale your database and handle increased storage needs. By using these tools, you can ensure that your store remains fast, secure, and reliable, even as it grows and scales to meet the needs of your customers.

The main difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is the level of complexity and scalability. Stack 01 is a more basic configuration that can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 is a more advanced configuration that requires 48 hours to deploy and includes additional features like end-to-end testing and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. By choosing the right stack for your needs, you can ensure that your store is set up for success and can handle the demands of your customers.

For creators who want to build and deploy their own digital stores, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to get started. You can purchase the kit and access the resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, and start building your own sovereign digital commerce stack today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: configure your Cloudflare Pages account and domain settings, create a NOWPayments account and obtain an API key, prepare your digital products and configure your store's settings, integrate NOWPayments with your store, configure your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, test your store's functionality, and go live and start processing transactions. By following these steps, you can create a fully functional crypto store that accepts payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies and delivers products instantly to customers.
